name: TimePicker field
summary: Type or pick one 24-hour time from hour and minute columns in the same field as DatePicker field, without antd.
highlights: One time in the Input field, typed or picked
Hour and minute columns; a pick commits at once
24-hour HH:mm value, empty is null, joins forms
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-timepicker>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue: the framework-free counterpart of antd TimePicker for one 24-hour time, so an app can drop antd for its time fields. It is the sibling of <aha-datepicker>: the same field (same tokens, small 32 · default 40 · large 48, error status, disabled, label, error and info message), with a clock glyph that turns into a clear button on hover and focus once a time is set. A click on the field or ArrowDown opens an hour column and a minute column below it (above when there is no room), in the browser top layer so a card or modal never clips it. The value is a 24-hour HH:mm string, or null when empty. A pick commits at once, so there is no OK button: an hour leaves the columns open for the minute, a minute closes them. The time can be typed (HH:mm; 9:30, 09.30 and 0930 are accepted too); typed text that is not a real time goes back to the last value when the field is left. Focus stays in the field, a role="combobox" over two role="listbox" columns, so the whole control is one tab stop. The element is form-associated and <aha-form-item> reads, validates and resets it.
codeNote: antd TimePicker → <aha-timepicker>: value (Dayjs) / onChange(time) → `value` (a 24-hour 'HH:mm' string, or null) + the `change` event, e.detail.value is the string or null (`input` fires with it too) — so dayjs(v, 'HH:mm') / d.format('HH:mm') wrappers go away · format="HH:mm" is the only format · needConfirm={false} is the only behaviour: a pick commits at once · placeholder → placeholder (default "HH:MM") · status error/warning → status (warning renders as error) · disabled → disabled · size small/middle/large → size small/default/large · allowClear → allow-clear (on by default; allow-clear="false" hides the button, and an emptied field goes back to the last value) · open / onOpenChange → the `open` property · aria-label / aria-labelledby → the same attributes, passed to the inner combobox · data-testid → on the host. Held, not supported, so these stay on the antd TimePicker: use12Hours, seconds, RangePicker, minuteStep and the other steps, disabledTime, renderExtraFooter. React 18: set `value` through a ref only when it differs (if (el.value !== (value ?? null)) el.value = value ?? null, so a parent render never wipes half-typed text) and listen with ref.current.addEventListener('change', …), since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; pass a boolean as present or absent ({...(disabled ? { disabled: '' } : {})}); disabled="false" reads as off. React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (:value.prop, @change).

spec.label: Box
spec.value: the <aha-input> field: height 40 (default) · radius 8 · padding-inline 12 8 · 1px #E3E3E3 (border-default) · 240 wide, full width in <aha-form-item>

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: small 32 (padding 8, gap 6) · default 40 · large 48 (16/24 text), radius 8, as <aha-input>; sm / lg accepted as aliases

spec.label: Hover / focus / open
spec.value: #E70E68 border on hover; focus and open #E70E68 border + 2px #E70E68@30% ring (focus-ring-soft), on the persistent wrapper

spec.label: Status
spec.value: error #1A1A1A border, 2px #1A1A1A ring on focus, aria-invalid; warning renders as error

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: #F1F1F1 fill, #EBEBEB border, #B5B5B5 text and glyph, no columns, no clear

spec.label: Text
spec.value: Plus Jakarta 14/21, tabular figures · placeholder #616161 (text-tertiary), as <aha-input>

spec.label: End glyph
spec.value: system-clock 16px #8A8A8A (icon-muted); with a time set it turns into system-x-circle 16px #616161, #1A1A1A on hover (the clear button, a 24×24 target), on hover and focus

spec.label: Panel
spec.value: #FFFFFF (bg-elevated), 1px #F1F1F1 (border-secondary), radius 8, shadow 0 6 20 #0000001A, 4px from the field, padding 4; fades and rises in (motion-mid, ease-out). Starts at the field's start edge and stays 8px inside the viewport

spec.label: Columns
spec.value: hour 00–23 and minute 00–59, 210 tall, 1px #F1F1F1 rule between them, hour on the left in every direction, as a time reads. The picked row is centred on open

spec.label: Rows
spec.value: 48×28 14/21, radius 4 · hover and the row the keyboard left in a column #F7F7F7 (bg-hover) · selected #FFFFFF on #E70E68 (the primary button pair, as a DatePicker day) · keyboard row 2px #E70E68 inset ring, 2px #FFFFFF on a selected row, shown only after a key

spec.label: Messages
spec.value: error-message: 12px system-warning-circle + 12/18 #1A1A1A text below, 4px gap · info-message: 12/18 #4A4A4A; both through <aha-field-error>

props.name: value
props.desc: The time as 24-hour HH:mm. Seconds in a value are dropped (09:30:15 reads as 09:30). The getter returns null when empty or not a real time; set null or '' to empty it

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Hint shown when empty; the default names the format the field reads

props.name: allow-clear
props.desc: With a time set, the clock glyph turns into a clear button on hover and focus; allow-clear="false" hides it, and an emptied field goes back to the last value

props.name: open
props.desc: Whether the columns show; set it to open or close them from code

props.name: status
props.desc: Error border and ring plus aria-invalid; warning renders as error

props.name: error-message
props.desc: Shown below the field while status is error, linked through aria-describedby

props.name: info-message
props.desc: Help text below the field while there is no error

props.name: label
props.desc: Visible label above the field, a real <label for> on the inner field

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Not interactive, grey fill, no columns; disabled="false" reads as off

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.desc: Name the inner combobox; aria-labelledby ids are resolved to their text across the shadow root and re-read on focus. A <label for> on the host works too

props.name: aria-describedby
props.desc: Ids describing the field, resolved on the inner field

props.name: hour-label / minute-label / clear-label
props.desc: The built-in strings, for a translated UI: the column names, read with each row (Hour 09), and the clear button's name

props.name: name
props.desc: Form field name: the element is form-associated, submits the value ('' when empty), resets to its first value and follows a disabled fieldset

props.name: input / change
props.desc: Composed; both fire on each pick, clear or commit of typed text (blur, Enter) that leaves a new value

a11y.role: the inner <input> is role="combobox" with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded and aria-controls naming both columns; each column is a role="listbox" named by hour-label or minute-label, each row a role="option" named with its column (Hour 09), aria-selected on the value; the field points at the keyboard row with aria-activedescendant
a11y.keyboard: ArrowDown opens; open: ArrowUp / ArrowDown move a row and wrap round the clock, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight change column, Home / End the first or last row, PageUp / PageDown five rows, Enter commits both columns (or a typed time) and closes, Escape closes and restores the text, Alt+ArrowUp closes, Tab closes. While typing, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End move the text caret. Closed: Enter commits the typed time and Escape restores the text. The columns and the clear button are tabindex=-1, so the control is one tab stop
a11y.note: Escape while the columns are open does not reach a surrounding modal. A click or tap outside closes them, and the keyboard ring shows only after a key, so a tap leaves nothing behind.

whenToUse.when: one 24-hour time in a product screen, filter or form: a deadline time, a reminder, a daily slot
a 12-hour clock, seconds, a time range, minute steps or disabled times: the antd composite themed by timePickerTheme
one date; put a TimePicker field beside it for a date and a time
a small fixed set of times (15-minute slots): a list beats two columns

opinion.note: Label it with a noun phrase (Deadline time); a placeholder is not a label. Keep the value as the HH:mm string end to end. Show the timezone beside the field when it is not the reader's.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the <aha-datepicker> field chrome with the TimePicker look from timePickerTheme (brand selected cell, #F7F7F7 hover cell, radius 8 panel); sizes 32 / 40 / 48 and the error status as Input.
